auth.unreachable: We can't reach the sign-in service right now. Try again in a minute.
engines.latencyBreakdown: {network} ms of network + {audio} ms of audio interface
engines.none: No engine found. k7 needs its audio engine to play your project: start it from the engine settings, then Refresh.
project.formatTooNew: This project was written by a newer version of k7 (format {fileLevel}). This k7 reads format {buildLevel} — update k7 to open it.
project.missingTitle: That project isn't in the workspace
project.missingBody: The workspace is here, but this project isn't: it was most likely renamed or removed since this page was opened. Go back to Projects and open it again.
project.emptyWorkspace: This workspace holds no project yet. It was created here and nothing has been added to it — go back to Projects and add one.
project.librariesBody: Shared modules and chains live in the origin's libraries, which every workspace sees. There is none yet, so nothing here could resolve a shared module. Add one below and the project opens.
project.benchFetching: Building the rig and mounting the library on this machine…
project.takenBody: {heldBy} has just opened it, and a project runs on one engine at a time, so this tab no longer drives the engine. You can still read and edit the files; nothing saved is lost.
project.takenBodyAnon: It has just been opened somewhere else, and a project runs on one engine at a time, so this tab no longer drives the engine. You can still read and edit the files; nothing saved is lost.
project.engineTakenBody: “{project}” has just been opened on the same engine, which drives one project at a time, so this tab no longer drives it. You can still read and edit the files. Take the engine back, or choose another engine to keep both running.
project.notYoursBody: It belongs to another account, which has not shared it with you, so this tab no longer drives it. You can still read and edit the files. Choose another engine, or ask its owner to share it with you from their Settings.
project.idleBody: Nothing has happened here for {minutes} minutes, so the project was unloaded from the engine — which is free for somebody else again — and this tab let go of it. Your files have not moved; everything was already saved. Resume to reopen it where you left off.
settings.consoleHint: A summing console over the whole mix: its channel after every lane's strip, its buss first on the master.
settings.consoleEmpty: No console in this account's libraries.
settings.noProject: Open a project to set it.
editorSettings.vimHint: Vim keybindings in the CUE editor — :w saves.
engine.crashed: The engine crashed and was restarted. The project is being sent to it again; anything playing stopped.
engine.safeMode: The engine crashed {crashes} times in a row, so it was restarted in safe mode: no external plugin is loaded. Restart the engine — from Settings → Engine in the k7 app, or by restarting the command-line engine — to load them again.
engine.safeModeLastPlugin: The last plugin it loaded was {plugin}.
engine.notPlayed: Not played: the engine is disconnected
engine.cannotPlayHere: The engine's sound cannot play in this page: {reason}
engine.warn.duplicateClip: Two clips in this project had the same id; the second one was renamed.
engine.warn.duplicateTrack: Two tracks in this project had the same id; the second one was renamed.
engine.warn.duplicateModule: Two modules in this project had the same id; the second one was renamed.
engine.warn.timeSignature: The time signature {signature} cannot be played; 4/4 is used instead.
engine.warn.unreadable: “{file}” is outside the folders the engine may read, so it was left out.
engine.warn.clipMissing: The audio file “{file}” could not be opened; that clip stays silent.
engine.warn.recordFolder: Recording is off: the record folder is outside the folders the engine may write to.
engine.warn.pluginFailed: The module “{name}” could not be loaded; its track plays without it.
engine.warn.hung: The audio engine is stuck inside a plugin. Restart the app.
engine.warn.internal: The engine hit an internal error. The Logs panel has the details.
transport.clockToSeconds: Position in bars and beats: click to read seconds, here and on the rulers
transport.clockToBars: Position in seconds: click to read bars and beats, here and on the rulers
commandBar.label: Command
engine.instrumentMissing: This module needs the sampled instrument “{instrument}”, which is not on the engine's machine. Download it where the engine runs: the Downloads section of this machine's engine page, opened from the k7 tray, or of Settings on the phone; or list it under “instruments” in the command-line engine's config file.
engineLoad.copyingTitle: Copying the project to the engine
engineLoad.copyingBody: Its audio files are copied to the machine the engine runs on before the project opens, so nothing is downloaded while it plays.
engineLoad.applyingTitle: Loading the project on the engine
engineLoad.applyingBody: The engine builds the song and loads its plugins.
engineLoad.warmingBody: The engine plays the first half-second with the sound off, so the first real play starts at once.
pluginScan.waitBody: This project uses plugins installed on the engine's machine, so it is sent to the engine once the engine has checked which ones are there.
pluginScan.stalled: The engine's plugin scan did not finish: the project went to the engine without it, and the plugins it had not reached show as missing.
engineSync.failedTitle: The project could not be loaded on the engine
engineSync.failedBody: Some of its audio files did not reach the engine's machine, so the project was not sent: played now, those clips would be silent.
engineSync.errorBody: The project's files could not be copied to the engine's machine, so the project was not sent.
engineMissing.title: Some sounds could not be loaded
engineMissing.body: The project plays, but without these: what they make will be silent or sound different.
engineMissing.refused: outside the folders the engine may open
engineMissing.logs: The log panel has the full paths.
laneFreeze.rendered: This engine does not have {vst}: the lane plays its automatic render.
laneFreeze.waiting: This engine does not have {vst}: the lane plays without it until a machine that has it makes a render.
import.title: Import DAW project?
import.body: {name} is another DAW's project file, not a k7 file. Import it as a new project in this workspace?
filesGate.title: Can't reach this engine's files
filesGate.body: The file service didn't answer. It may be stopped; the details below say what came back.
midi.unavailableDesktop: No Web MIDI in this window — open k7 in the browser (K7 DAW's tray menu: Open in Browser) to record MIDI
midi.unavailable: No MIDI — Web MIDI was refused or is unavailable here
midi.noMidiIn: Nothing records MIDI into {track}: wire a MIDI node to it
transport.meterEdit: Time signature — click to change it
transport.meterAsk: Time signature, beats per bar / note value (4/4, 3/4, 6/8)
transport.loopOn: Loop is on — click to turn it off
transport.loopOff: Loop — play a region over and over (4 bars from the playhead, or what you selected)
transport.loading: Loading this project — the engine cannot play it yet
transport.noArm: Record mode is on, and no track can record — pick a track with an input, then press Record again
status.engineStarting: the audio engine is starting up
editorPane.label: {file} — editor
graph.selectTrack: Select a track in the timeline to see its chain.
graph.noStrip: No strip in this song: a strip is a Mixer module at the end of a track.
graph.noChainFrom: No chain takes {track} as its source.
chainsUi.stackViewHint: Stack view — a column per track, the mix last (ui stack)
chainsUi.zoomFitHint: Zoom fit — frame the whole graph
chainsUi.organizeHint: Organize — lay the graph out again (graph organize)
chainsUi.seamsTitle: Where a module can be added
chainsUi.addModuleEnd: Add a module at the end
chainsUi.alternativeOn: Alternative "{name}" — the settings this node is playing now
chainsUi.alternativeSwitch: Play this node with the "{name}" settings instead
chainsUi.addTapHint: Add a tap — then pick its sample
chainsUi.addTapOnNote: Add a tap on note {note} — then pick its sample
chainsUi.noteOfKit: The note the kit plays it on
chainsUi.noteAnswers: The note it answers to — click to type another
chainsUi.soundOfKit: Its sound is the kit's: velocity layers and round-robins
chainsUi.pickSample: pick a sample from a library's samples/
chainsUi.frozenAt: Frozen here — everything upstream is playing as one render. Unfreeze from the right-click menu.
chainsUi.frozenInside: Inside a render — this node is baked and is not running. Unfreeze the point downstream of it.
chainsUi.frozenAutoHere: Frozen automatically — this VST and everything upstream play as a render, so an engine without the VST can play it. Touch a control to edit it live.
chainsUi.frozenAutoInside: Inside {module}'s automatic render. Touch a control to edit it live.
graphWarn.chainFromUnknown: chain '{chain}': from '{from}' is not a track or chain
graphWarn.chainMixedLane: chain '{chain}': track '{track}' holds audio AND sequences, and '{module}' takes {wants} — all of it goes through it. Split the lane: '{track}#audio:' and '{track}#midi:'
graphWarn.chainStepUnknown: chain '{chain}': step module '{module}' is not a module or module node{hint}
graphWarn.chainTransitionWired: chain '{chain}': '{module}' is a transition, and a transition is not wired — a cut names it (fadeIn(with: "{module}") on a shot of a picture lane)
graphWarn.outIsInput: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' is a live input — signal comes FROM it, not to it
graphWarn.outIsCamera: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' is a camera — picture comes FROM it, not to it
graphWarn.outIsMidiDevice: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' is a MIDI device — notes come FROM it, not to it
graphWarn.outIsPictureLane: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' is a picture lane — only a camera's or a shape's picture lands on one, or a run of shaders nothing feeds (a fade's chain:)
graphWarn.outIsTrack: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' is a track — only a live input's or a MIDI device's signal lands on a lane
graphWarn.outUnknown: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' is not a chain or io sink
graphWarn.outNegativeGain: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' has a negative gain
graphWarn.outBadPort: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' leaves '{source}' through '{port}', which is not one of its outputs ({outputs})
graphWarn.outRenderPort: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' is no input of RENDER — it takes the picture on 'in' and the sound on 'audio'
graphWarn.outRenderSoundNotMix: chain '{chain}': out '{out}' — only the mix can be the video's sound for now (MIX: ["RENDER#audio"]); this one is not in the export
graphWarn.moduleAssetMissing: module '{module}': {param} '{ref}' is not in this module's assets/
graphWarn.inputNoChannel: input '{input}': no channel — it feeds nothing
graphWarn.inputTrackDisabled: input '{input}': track '{track}' is disabled — it records nothing
graphWarn.inputTrackGroup: input '{input}': track '{track}' is a group — it holds no material
graphWarn.inputTrackStrudel: input '{input}': track '{track}' is a strudel lane — its pattern is the source
graphWarn.trackTwoInputs: track '{track}': fed by two inputs ('{first}', '{second}') — only one can win
graphWarn.moduleChannelNotInput: module '{module}': channel is for an io "in" module, but '{module}' is not one
graphWarn.assemblyNameTaken: assembly '{assembly}': a node of this project is already called that
graphWarn.assemblyMemberMissing: assembly '{assembly}': member '{member}' names '{node}', which this project has not got
graphWarn.chainCycle: chain '{chain}': is part of a cycle
panel.eventEmpty: No event open — click a clip, or double-click a track's header
footer.rollBadge: piano roll: {mode} — Esc or a backs out
footer.waveBadge: waveform: {mode} — Esc or a backs out
footer.errorsTitle.one: {n} error in this project — the timeline and chains won't load until it is fixed
footer.errorsTitle.other: {n} errors in this project — the timeline and chains won't load until they're fixed
footer.notesNone: No notes in this project: a note is a node of @meta/doc, wired from what it is about
footer.notesHide: Hide the {n} note(s) on the graph
footer.notesShow: Show the {n} note(s) on the graph
footer.mixNone: No strip in this song: a strip is a Mixer module at the end of a track
footer.mixOne: Mix panel — one strip, nothing to line up
footer.mixMany: Mix panel — this song's {n} strips lined up
home.unknownCommand: "{line}" is not a command on this screen
repos.noFilesTitle: The server's file service is not answering, so the list of your projects cannot be read.
repos.noFilesAside: Your other settings are in the {settings}.
repos.empty: No workspace yet. A workspace is a folder that holds your projects, kept in step on each of your devices.
repos.openAndCreate: Open {name} and create a project in it
repos.active: Open in its workspace: the project the engine plays there
ws.newBody: Made on the server, and kept in step with your other devices by k7. There is nothing to configure: the first project is chosen by opening it.
ws.removeBody: Its {count} project(s) and every file in it are deleted, and cannot be brought back. Type the workspace's name to confirm.
shape.arrangementWhat: record, write and arrange tracks on a timeline — starts with one synth track
shape.mixWhat: two turntables and a crossfader for mixing tracks live, with an empty set list
shape.videoWhat: a timeline for video clips and their sound, and a window that shows the picture
shape.liveWhat: plug in a mic or guitar and play through effects, no timeline — use headphones: what comes in goes straight to the speakers
shape.liveVideoWhat: the same, plus your webcam on screen — use headphones here too
project.newHint: Create a project in this workspace
project.newHintAny: Create a project, in the workspace you choose
project.needWorkspace: Create a workspace first: a project is a folder in one
project.newBody: Pick what kind of project it is; you can add tracks, effects and video to any of them later.
project.deleteBody: The folder is moved out of the workspace, into its recycle bin.
project.deleteKept: Its contents stay in the workspace's _recycle_bin/ folder.
project.copyNone: no other workspace to copy into
demo.badgeHint: A demo is put back as it shipped each time k7 restarts. Copy it to another workspace to keep your changes.
demo.banner: This is a demo: it is put back as it shipped when k7 restarts, and your changes go with it. Copy it to keep them.
demo.noTarget: You have no other workspace to copy into yet — create one on the projects page, then copy this demo there.
demo.noFiles: Your workspaces cannot be reached right now — try again in a moment.
project.copyBody: The folder is copied into the chosen workspace. The original is untouched.
project.missingModules: {project} is created, but your library does not have these modules yet, so they stay silent until an admin adds them: {modules}
project.firstBody: This workspace is empty. Pick what kind of project to start with — it decides what you see first. You can add more projects beside it later.
name.noDot: a name cannot start with a dot
repos.pickFile: Pick a file to read it.
repos.binaryFile: A binary file: nothing to show here.
projects.noFilesBlocked: the server's file service is not answering — it is the one that makes projects
libs.title: Libraries
libs.missingBody: No library is bundled with this install, and k7 opens no project without one. The libraries come with the app: update or reinstall it.
libs.haveBody: The modules and chains every project inherits, each library under its own name. They are bundled with the app and read-only: a library changes with an app update.
libs.noticeMissing: No library yet — k7 opens no project without one.
libs.noticeFailed: The app holds no folder for some libraries.
libs.engineTooOld: @{name} v{version} needs level {need}; this engine's machine runs level {level} — update k7 there
downloads.title: Downloads: {done} of {total} done
downloads.heading: Downloads
engine.title: This machine's engine
engine.hint: This machine's engine, run by the k7 tray: it plays your projects on this machine's audio interface.
engine.stoppedByYou: Stopped — start it again when you need it
engine.audioHint: The engine takes the first one that is plugged in. Move one up to prefer it.
engine.asioHint: The engine is on Windows' shared output, not your interface's own driver: only 2 channels a side, and more latency. Put “{driver}” first to get all its inputs.
engine.lanHint: Who on this machine's network may use the engine. A device anywhere else goes through a server it is listed at.
engine.lanOpenOn: A phone or a computer on this network uses the engine without pairing.
engine.lanOpenOff: A device on this network asks to pair first, and you approve it on this machine.
engine.pluginsHint: What the engine found installed on this machine. Rescan after installing one.
engine.downloadsHint: The sampled instruments the engine can play. Nothing is downloaded until you ask; the piano alone is 750 MB.
engine.noInstruments: The engine has not listed its instruments yet
engine.instrument.queued: waiting for the download before it · {size}
ws.needLibraries: No library is installed — the libraries come with the app
importDrop.title: Import this project
importDrop.body: {file} was dropped on {workspace}. It is translated into a project of its own — the file itself is not kept. What did not survive the translation is listed once it is done.
importDrop.working: Translating — a project with its audio takes a moment.
importDrop.refused: {what} is not a project this can import — drop a .dawproject, or an Ableton project folder zipped. A lone .als names its samples by path, so it is imported from the file tree instead.
hc.noWorkspaces: no workspace yet — start with: system workspace new <name>
hc.noFiles: the server's file service is not answering
hc.copyIntoProject: {to} is itself a project — the copy would never be listed in it
hc.deleteArmed: {path} — the folder will be moved to the workspace's recycle bin. To do it: project delete confirm {path}
hc.nothingArmed: nothing has been named — project delete init {name} first
hc.notWhatWasArmed: that is not what was named ({what}) — nothing was deleted
hc.workspaceMade: + {workspace} — empty; open it to make a project in it
settings.title: Settings
settings.trayHint: The engine, the audio interface and this machine's own settings are set on that machine, in the k7 tray or the command-line engine's config file: they need a process on it. Here, what a browser can change.
menuEntity.shot: a shot on a picture lane
menuEntity.note: a note on the piano roll
menuEntity.tap: a sound of a rack, on its card
cmdMenu.label: offer on a right-click on…
cmds.discardBody: The shortcuts, names and icons changed here will not be saved.
cmds.title: Commands
cmds.subtitle: their name, their icon, their shortcut and the order menus list them in — for you, in every browser of yours
cmds.keyHint: click then press a key — Esc cancels, ⌫ removes (⇧ passes through, ⌘/⌃/⌥ stay the browser's)
cmds.tookKey: {key} now runs this command; {command} lost it.
cmds.captureHint: Press the key. Esc cancels, Backspace removes it.
stems.title: stem separation
stems.selectLabel: the chain that splits a song into stems
stems.body: What “Separate the stems” and a deck's knobs use. A chain of a single offline step — the model it names has to be on this machine.
instrumental.title: instrumental
instrumental.selectLabel: the chain that gives a song without its voice
instrumental.none: — none: this machine makes no instrumental —
instrumental.body: What k7's “Make instrumental” asks for. The same model as above, over a chain whose module declares one output named instrumental.
settings.chains.title: Separation chains
settings.chains.hint: Which of your library's cold chains this engine separates a record with, and makes an instrumental with. It is the machine's own setting, in its engine-host.json: another engine may answer differently.
settings.chains.noCold: Your libraries hold no cold chain — one whose single step is an offline module that separates. Write one under {dir}.
settings.chains.unavailable: This machine can't run it yet: {reason}
settings.chains.noMachine: No machine answers — start the engine on the machine these chains run on.
settings.commandsHint: Commands — rename, reorder, bind a key
master.alreadyFloor: nothing to bring down — the output is at the floor already
master.fixed: output at {db} dB ({trim} dB) — peak aimed at {target} dB
master.notADb: “{arg}” is not a level in dB
master.nothingToFix: nothing to catch — the last pass did not clip (give a level in dB to force it)
master.noMeter: no meter on this screen — give a level in dB
share.pick: Pick what to export, then choose where it goes.
share.filmNoPath: This device cannot hand a folder to the film render: export the video from the Export panel instead
share.tracksRendering: Rendering the tracks — the zip downloads when it is ready
share.noMp4: This browser cannot make MP4, so the video is WebM — Chrome or Edge can make MP4.
rack.created: rack {ref} created — wire it from the graph
undo.processBody: {files} — the bounced file will be restored to what it was.
clip.noArmedTrack: no track armed — arm one with A / r
clip.onsetHint: click adds an onset · drag a mark to move it · click it to remove it
clip.warpHint: double-click drops a stretch point · drag its blue handle to say which beat it falls on · right-click it to remove it · the grey lines are the onsets, for reference
tapChain.title: {tap} on {node} — its own chain
tapChain.empty: This tap plays on the kit's main output. Add a module and it leaves the kit through a chain of its own.
tapChain.routed: This tap leaves the kit through these modules, in order, then the mix.
clip.gainHint: This event's own gain, −6 to +6 dB, before the lane's chain. Double-click for 0 dB.
clip.loopOn: Loop this event: it plays its window twice, and its loop points appear in the ruler
clip.loopOff: Stop looping: the event plays its window once
clip.trimHint: moves the event's window — the audio is untouched
clip.countingIn: counting in — the take starts after
clip.noTake: no take — start the transport with recording armed
pl.noAudioRow: no row of this playlist has any audio
pl.wontPlay: this file does not play in this browser
pl.separateHint: Separate every record into drums / bass / other / vocals, so one can be taken out at the desk
pl.nothingToSeparate: no row of this playlist has audio to separate
pl.noHit: No audio file answers to that.
pl.emptyBody: This playlist names no record. Search the workspace's audio files for one, or write the lines under {items} on the left — it is the same file.
pl.alreadySplit: already separated into stems — the preparation will skip it
pl.footerHint: the rows play one after another; the records are the workspace's audio files
pl.noChainYet: This machine cannot separate yet. Choose the chain once in the settings, under I/O — or {cmd}.
pl.separateCost: Each song takes several minutes, one at a time. The ones already separated are skipped, and an interrupted separation picks up where it was — starting again costs nothing.
tool.pointer: arrow — grab, frame, put the caret down
tool.cut: blade — cut the event at the beat pointed at
tool.erase: eraser — take the event off the lane
tool.mute: mute — silence the event without taking it off
tool.crossfade: crossfade — click the end of an event to fade it into the next, drag to size it, Alt removes it
tool.cutAtHead: nothing to cut: the cut falls on {name}'s start
tool.cutAtTail: nothing to cut: the cut falls on {name}'s end
tool.shotNoMute: a shot has no mute of its own — m hides its lane
grid.clipboardHasEvents: the clipboard holds events, not notes
grid.nothingToPaste: nothing to paste here — it all falls off the keyboard
grid.nothingToDelete: nothing to delete — the caret is on no note
roll.selection: selection: {steps} × {unit} · {from}–{to} — drag a note in it to move them all · ⇧L loops it · v cancels
roll.moveOccupied: can't move there — a note that stays is in the way
roll.hintKeys: x deletes · Ctrl: off the grid · pinch or Ctrl+wheel zooms · middle-drag pans
roll.hintTouch: long-press a note for its menu · pinch to zoom · two fingers to pan
metro.floorHint: the lowest is {min}% — for silence, click the metronome
seq.doubleHint: ×2 — the sequence twice as long, played twice
pls.brokenFile: this file does not parse — open the text to repair it
pls.emptyRepo: This workspace holds no playlist yet. They live in {dir}, at its root — so kept with your songs, and the same whichever project is open.
pls.notAPlaylist: does not read as a playlist
pls.emptyFile: empty file — the first change will write this template
pls.noFileYet: no file yet — the first change will create it
pls.addUnsupported: `items` in this file is not a list, or the file does not read — add the line by hand
pls.moveUnsupported: `items` in this file is not a list, or the file does not read — change the line by hand
pls.brokenYaml: the text does not parse — the list shows the last readable version
history.empty: No history yet: every edit of this song will be listed here.
tasks.attachHint: Pin the task to this song, at the playhead
tasks.attachNone: No song open to pin a task to
tasks.tagHint: Tag this project — shown beside it on the home page
refs.title: Reference tracks
res.empty: Nothing imported into this project yet. Drop an audio or video file on a lane: it lands in clips/ and shows up here, to hear and place again.
res.hint: Drag one onto a lane to place it again — audio on a track, a video on a picture lane.
res.missing: The file this clip names is gone from the project
res.emptyFilter: Nothing of this kind in the project.
status.res.dropOnPicture: A video goes on a picture lane — drop it on one
refs.empty: This workspace holds no reference track yet. They live in {dir}, at its root — the mixes you listen against, kept with your songs and the same whichever project is open.
refs.cannotPlay: this browser cannot decode this file
tl.toolPicked: {tool} — click an event · esc or a gives the arrow back
ed.trashBody: It goes to the recycle bin: nothing is erased right away.
ext.noEngineBody: Surfaces live on the machine that holds the working copies: with no engine there is nothing to drive.
ext.noProject: A surface joins the project the engine is already holding. Open one in the editor and this list will fill.
meter.clipped: — it clipped during the last pass
meter.hint:
{reading}
song output — {level} dB (0 = unity, +{max} the top of the fader)
meter.fixHint: bring the song's output down, for a peak at {target} dB
mst.oneUnmapped: one of its components is not mapped
mst.someUnmapped: {n} of its components are not mapped
mst.severalModules: — a mastering desk normally describes just one.
mst.noneResolve: none of its controls resolves for now
mst.portrait: This surface is the portrait of ONE quick-master module, and
srf.drawnByShell: A “{type}” surface is drawn by the shell, not here.
wave.listenHint: listen — the file's from/to window, at its own tempo
extsrf.editorOnly: “{ui}” belongs to the editor, not to a surface.
ruler.position: position in the song — clicking puts the playhead there
rb.samePad: two pads carry the same file: {file}
roll.tool.label: Tool: {name}
roll.select: drag frames · a note moves, stretches, is set
roll.create: drag draws a note — its pitch where you start, its length where you let go
roll.remove: clicking a note takes it off
roll.takes: drag a span across the takes · click one to play it there · ● records another
tl.timelineTitle: {name}, {length} — placed whole on a lane, it plays through that lane — right-click to rename
tl.newTimelineLane: new lane in this timeline (timeline lane new)
cb.newNodeBody: The module, then the node's name — for example audio/reverb hall.
cb.noQuotes: no quotes: they would count as arguments
rb.title: new rack
rb.hint: drag samples onto the pads · click to listen · the names become the symbols
extsrf.surfacesAre: Surfaces are the files of {dir}; the address names one by its file name.
rb.noRack: no library holds {module} — add a module with `type: rack` there first
rb.nameShape: the name becomes a folder: letters, digits, _ and - only
ext.noOpenProject: No project open on the engine.
ext.noSurfacesBody: A project declares its screens in its {folder} folder. The open one declares none.
mod.fileHint: the module's own file — one save counts for every instance of it
project.renameBody: The folder is renamed. Everything in the project follows it; only its address changes.
project.renameWarning: A link to the old address stops answering, and so does an editor already open on it. If this machine is playing the project, the engine stops.
project.renameSame: that is the name it has already
engineSwitch.hint: The sound comes out of {engine}'s speakers or audio interface, not this device's — click to play on another engine
engineSwitch.hintHere: Played by the engine {engine} and streamed to this browser — click to play on another engine
engineSwitch.noSound: No sound — the engine is not running
engineSwitch.noSoundHint: The project is open, but the audio engine is not playing it. Start it from the engine settings.
leave.unsaved: Some changes are not saved yet. Leave this project anyway?
engineSwitch.thisMachineHint: The engine's mix is streamed to this browser; its own speakers keep playing
engineSwitch.theEngineHint: The engine's own speakers or audio interface
engineSwitch.noSpeakers: This engine has no speakers: it is only heard here

undo.textEnd: No more typing to undo in this file — press again to undo the project's last change

frozen.title: Frozen chains
frozen.summary: Chains you build once and reuse: to process a track or a clip, or to play a live input through. They are built on the bench, where you hear them, and kept in your account's library.
frozen.mineEmpty: None yet — New chain opens the bench: put modules between the input and the fader, then save it from the project bar.
frozen.coldEmpty: The libraries hold no cold chain.
frozen.noServer: No file service answers for this account.
frozen.duplicateBody: A copy of {ref}, yours to edit, under this name.
frozen.deleteBody: A project naming it will no longer find it.
frozen.badName: Letters, digits, '-' and '_' only, starting with a letter or a digit.
frozen.saveSlot: Save in a slot of this machine's engine
frozen.slotSaved: {ref} is saved in a slot of this machine's engine. Enable it on the engine page.
slots.title: Slots
slots.hint: Frozen chains this machine keeps compiled. The enabled one plays with no page open, and comes back when the engine restarts; opening a project on the engine disables it.
slots.none: No slot yet: save a chain into one from the Frozen chains page.
slots.footswitchBody: The MIDI CC a pedal sends, on any channel: each press bypasses the chain and the next brings it back. Set a latching pedal to momentary. Leave empty for none.
slots.footswitchBad: A CC is a number from 0 to 127.
frozen.slotSending: Sending the chain and its files to {host}…
frozen.slotSavedOn: {ref} is saved in a slot of {host}. Enable it on the engines page.
slots.remoteHint: An engine you own, reached through its server: what it plays with nobody attached.
bench.saveAs: Save as one of your chains
bench.saveBody: What sits between the input and the fader becomes @account/<name>, which projects process with and an engine's slot plays.
hc.cameraUnavailable: this screen cannot become a camera
hc.noCameraHere: this browser cannot open a camera here — it needs https and a camera
cameraMode.retrying: the server is out of reach, trying again… {error}
synchist.restoreBodyDevice: Every text file goes back to what it was at that point, on every device. Audio and other binary files are left as they are. The restore is an edit like any other: what it replaces stays in this history.
synchist.kept: Binary files are left as they are, since this device does not keep their bytes: {files}
synchist.noRoom: This workspace's history could not start, but its edits are still captured: {error}
git.connectBody: The workspace becomes a git repository of its own, or joins the one you name. Nothing is pushed until you push.
git.noLfsTitle: This host does not store large files
git.cloneHint: Bring a git repository onto this device as a new workspace
git.cloneBody: The repository comes down as a workspace of its own, with its large files.
roam.title: On your other devices
roam.hint: A workspace appears here once it is connected to a git remote: git is how its files travel.
roam.cloneBody: The repository comes down as a workspace of its own, with its large files. Its address is the one it has on your other device.
git.keyCopyFailed: The page could not copy: the key is selected, copy it by hand.
git.keyIntro: k7 signs in with this device's own key. Add its public key to the host as a deploy key (or to your account's SSH keys), then connect.
git.sshOnly: k7 syncs over SSH only: use an ssh address such as git@host:me/songs.git, not https://.
git.keyInstall: On the host: a repository's Deploy keys (with write access to push), or your account's SSH keys.
git.keyShared: This key is shared with your other Apple devices through iCloud Keychain
git.keyLocal: This key stays on this device
git.hostUnknown: First contact with {host}. Its key is:
git.hostUnknownNote: Compare it with the one the host shows, then trust it. Nothing was sent to the server.
git.hostChanged: The key of {host} is not the one you trusted
git.hostChangedNote: Either the server was reinstalled or something sits between you and it. k7 does not go on. If the server's owner confirms the new key, forget the old one: k7 will then show the new key for you to trust.
git.headline: {remote} · {branch}
git.pullFirst: The remote has new commits: pull first, then push.
git.busy: Another git operation is running on this workspace: try again in a moment.
git.mergePending: A merge is waiting for your choices: finish or abort it first.
git.deviceOnly: Git is only available in the app on your own computer, not on a server.
git.commitFirst: Commit your changes first: a pull needs a committed workspace.
git.emptyRemote: The remote has no commits yet: push to start it.
git.commitBody: Every changed file of the workspace goes into one commit.
git.noChanges: Nothing changed since the last commit.
git.lfsHint: Stored as a large file: git keeps a small pointer, the host keeps the bytes
git.leftOut: {name} ({size}) is over 2 GB, more than a git host takes: it is left out of this commit and stays in your workspace. Shrink or remove it to commit it.
git.identityNeeded: Name the author of your commits (kept in Settings, on this device).
git.mergeBody: Both sides changed the same things. Choose what to keep for each; nothing changes in the workspace until you finish.
git.binaryBoth: A file that cannot be merged line by line: keep one, or both (theirs is saved beside it).
git.bothNamed: Both items are kept: theirs is named after its author.
git.bothBeside: Theirs is saved beside the file, under a free name.
git.abortBody: The workspace stays exactly as it was before the pull; your choices are forgotten.
git.lockedByMerge: A merge is waiting for your choices: finish or abort it before editing.
git.identityHint: The name and email that sign your commits and head the user menu, on this device only.
pl.filesNotLoaded: the workspace's files are not read yet
